＊Sakaki＊＠１５７＿０１２Oh...￥Good. I've been waiting for you.
Did you need something?
Am I in trouble?
Did you need something?
Am I in trouble?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５７＿０１３Sorry for calling you￥over like this.＝＠１５７＿０１４It's nothing all that￥important, really...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５７＿０１５There's just something￥I wanted to show you.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５７＿０１６Huh?￥No...?＝＠１５７＿０１７Did you maybe￥get the wrong idea?
＠１５７＿０１８I didn't call you here￥to scold you.
Then what is it?
Thought I'd get scolded.
Then what is it?
Thought I'd get scolded.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５７＿０１９Well, there's just something￥I wanted to show you...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５７＿０２０Like I said...￥I'm not going to scold you.＝＠１５７＿０２１We just got the latest data￥on Elan, and I thought I'd￥let you know.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５７＿０２２I'm sorry for calling you here￥over something so minor.＝＠１５７＿０２３If you're not interested, fine.￥Go back to your room.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿００１The latest data on Elan￥came in today.＝＠１５８＿００２I'm about to load it into￥the Archives computer.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿００３The images are so beautiful...￥I wanted you to see them first.
That makes me happy.
Okay if I see it first?
That makes me happy.
Okay if I see it first?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿００４Really? I'm glad!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿００５Everyone will get to￥see it eventually...＝＠１５８＿００６Just this once, as a special￥treat. Come on, let's look.
Not fair to the others.
Our little secret, then?
Unfair to the others...
Our little secret, then?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿００７You're right...＝＠１５８＿００８Then you can watch it later￥in the Monitor Room with￥everyone else.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿００９Sorry for calling you here￥at this hour.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０１０Right!￥Don't tell the other candidates.

＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０１１See? Isn't it gorgeous...＝＠１５８＿０１２I wonder how many more times￥new data like this will be￥sent to us...＝＠１５８＿０１３And the selection exams are￥in their final stretch now.＝＠１５８＿０１４Thinking about that makes me￥feel so sentimental...＝＠１５８＿０１５Elan... I'm sure you￥can make it there.＝＠１５８＿０１６There's not much time left,￥but... do your best.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０１７Everyone feels differently￥about Elan...＝＠１５８＿０１８People around you will tell￥you all sorts of things and￥expect a lot from you...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０１９But I want you to put your own￥feelings ahead of what others￥want.＝＠１５８＿０２０You're the one going, after all.
Yes, I understand.
I'll be fine.
Yes, I understand.
I'll be fine.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０２１Of course!￥I don't need to worry about￥you, do I?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０２２Of course.￥You've always got a mind of￥your own, don't you?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０２３I hope you qualify and do￥great things on Elan, but...＝＠１５８＿０２４It's a little lonely, too.＝＠１５８＿０２５Once the exam period is over,￥you'll all leave this place...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０２６I feel like I'm￥being left behind...
You'll go someday too.
Not sure what to say...
We'll all go someday.
Not sure what to say...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０２７That's true, but...￥this whole project is so￥everyone can move there someday.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０２８It's just, when I thought again￥about not seeing you anymore,￥it made me feel lonely.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０２９I know. I'm sorry.＝＠１５８＿０３０It's just, I've been watching￥all of you for months, you know?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０３１And now it feels strange,￥like watching my kids￥leave the nest.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５８＿０３２Silly of me, since I'm not your￥mother. Never mind!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿００１Well, I'd better get this data￥filed for the records.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５０＿００２I really hope you qualify.＝＠１５０＿００３I'm rooting for you. Good luck!
